informal_statement: The unit-chord arc length as a function of enclosed area.
reason: Equivalent in the declared constructor/section context. At MorgansArcFunction.lean:267-268, the source contract is `noncomputable def arc (x : ℝ) : ℝ := ell (θOf x)`. The unit-chord normalized area and arc length are constructed on 0 < theta < pi. The inverse is used geometrically only at positive area; its explicit totalization is not confused with an inverse outside that domain.
